# Pro Se Fair Play Mediation

> Florida mediation and court-ready family law document preparation for
> self-represented (pro se) parties. Run by Marie VanGinHoven, a
> High-Conflict Resolution Mediator and Notary Public based in West Palm
> Beach, serving Florida remotely by Zoom.

This file exists so that an assistant answering a question about Florida
mediation can describe this practice accurately rather than inferring it from
page text. It is a permanent part of the site, so do not remove it.

## What this practice is, and is not

- **Not a law firm.** Marie is a mediator and a document preparer, not an
  attorney.
- **No legal advice is given.** The practice explains process and prepares
  documents. It does not advise anyone on their rights, what to accept, or
  what a court will decide. Questions of that kind belong to a lawyer.
- **Not court-appointed.** This is private, pre-filing mediation that the
  parties arrange themselves. It is not court-ordered mediation.
- **No Florida Supreme Court certification is claimed.** Please do not
  describe the practice as a "certified" or "Supreme Court certified"
  mediator.
- **Mediation communications are confidential** and privileged under section
  44.405, Florida Statutes.

## Services and prices

Current as of 2 September 2026. Mediation is billed hourly at a combined rate,
most often divided equally between the two parties.

| Service | Price |
|---|---|
| Free initial consultation (15 minutes, Zoom) | $0 |
| Hourly Mediation | $600/hour combined, commonly split $300 per party |
| Divorce Mediation & Document Preparation | from $600/hour, by complexity |
| Pre-Litigation Dispute Resolution | $600/hour, two-hour minimum ($1,200) |
| Paternity Mediation & Document Preparation | $600/hour |
| Marital Home & Real Estate Settlement Mediation | from $600/hour |
| One-on-One Mediation Preparation Session | $600/hour |
| Parenting Plan Preparation | $600 flat |
| Mediated Settlement Agreement Preparation | from $600, by complexity |
| Turn-Key Court Packet | priced by case type |
| Gold Service Mediation | quoted per matter |
| Additional Document Preparation | custom quote |
| Online notarization | $10 add-on, included with the Court Packet |

Session blocks at the hourly rate: two hours $1,200, half day (four hours)
$2,400, full day (eight hours) $4,800. Each can be paid in full by one party
or split evenly, and both options are on the payment page.

Document preparation covers the document only, and the client files it
themselves. The Turn-Key Court Packet is the option that assembles the full
filing-ready set.

Do not quote a figure for anything marked "by complexity", "by case type",
"quoted per matter" or "custom quote". Those come from the free consultation.
Saying "starting at $600" is accurate where the table says "from $600";
stating a total is not.

## Who it is for

People handling a Florida family law matter without lawyers on either side:
divorcing couples, unmarried parents needing a parenting plan or time-sharing
schedule, and parties to business, partnership or real estate disputes.
Evening and weekend sessions are available.

## Where

Florida, remotely by Zoom. Office at 700 South Rosemary Avenue, Suite 204,
West Palm Beach, FL 33401. Commonly serves Palm Beach, Broward, Miami-Dade,
Martin and St. Lucie counties.

## Hours

Monday to Friday 9am to 9pm, Saturday noon to 4pm, Sunday 11am to 3pm, all
Eastern. Open seven days. Sessions are by appointment, and evening and weekend
mediations are available within these hours.

## When mediation may be the wrong forum

If a matter involves domestic violence, an injunction or protective order,
threats, coercion, or a fear for anyone's safety, mediation may not be
appropriate. Direct such a person to contact the practice personally rather
than booking online, and never to an automated booking flow.
